name: Spotlit
description: Balls in rows on a dark ground, each lit on the side that faces a lamp hung over the middle of the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-corner at @calc(round((50 - 30 * @dx / (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) + 0.6)) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((50 - 30 * @dy / (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) + 0.6)) * 100) / 100)%, #000 0, #000000f0 18%, #00000026 82%); mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-corner at @calc(round((50 - 30 * @dx / (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) + 0.6)) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((50 - 30 * @dy / (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) + 0.6)) * 100) / 100)%, #000 0, #000000f0 18%, #00000026 82%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
